publication_name: Industrial production index, absolute, not seasonally adjusted
access_description: OpenDOSM CSV at storage.dosm.gov.my/ipi/ipi.csv. No API key. Only series abs and the index column are stored. Growth rows and index_sa are not.
conditions: DOSM authorises copying, publishing, distributing, adapting and commercial and non-commercial use, and requires the statement Data source: Department of Statistics Malaysia. The catalogue page also says this data is made open under CC BY 4.0. Do not present a transformation as the Department's own.
revision_behaviour: The catalogue says the most recent one year of data may be revised. The file is latest-revised, not a vintage panel. A changed index is a new row.
unresolved_questions: The index uses inputs from other bodies. The stored series is the DOSM index published under the catalogue licence, not those bodies' source files. AI processing is not named.
evidence_note: The catalogue says the index is quantity of output with base 2015 = 100, and that the data is made open under the Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International License (CC BY 4.0). A non-persisting fetch stored only the absolute index: May 2026 139.382, June 2026 147.11, July 2026 144.209, August 2026 147.996. The seasonally adjusted column and the growth_yoy value 4.954 are not stored. This is a production index, not a growth rate, and it is not labelled as AI demand.  The current file is latest-revised. It is not a historical vintage panel. includeHistory is not requested. An unchanged value keeps the first observation id. A changed value is a new row. Official gaps are omitted. None of Sahm, SLOOS, Census advance orders, MACRO_CONDITIONS_PANEL, or PERIOD_LEVEL_CHANGE consume this dataset id. Sahm requires bls.ln.LNS14000000. SLOOS requires fed.sloos.SUBLPDCILS_N.Q. Census advance orders requires census.m3.adv.MDM.NO. MACRO_CONDITIONS_PANEL requires those three dataset ids. PERIOD_LEVEL_CHANGE requires bls.ln.LNS14000000.
